theme: Open water, open calendar — a few trip threads to tie off before you sail out of range.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. The calendar is clear while you're mid-charter in Croatia, so the day is yours — but a handful of travel threads want a signal window before Saturday's disembark and next weekend's Florida landing.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat transfers still open
needsAttention.detail: The charter ends at noon Saturday Sept 19; the Komolac to Cavtat transfer, an early-afternoon bag hold, and a ~5:15 AM Sunday checkout for the 7:30 flight all need arranging from dry land before you're back out of range.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 20 to Oct 5 rental car
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sunday Sept 20 at 3:55 PM with no car booked. The full-size SUV for the Florida cycle is now certain, not a hedge — lock it before facing walk-up rates jet-lagged on a Sunday.

needsAttention.title: St Pete landing gap Sept 20 to 22
needsAttention.detail: Two nights in the St Pete area before the Tuesday Sept 22 kid pickup are still unbooked, though the rest of the Florida cycle is locked. A p1 that's been sitting open.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV — book this week
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas is the hardest rental in that market and sells out; a refundable hold now costs nothing. Overdue since Sept 14.

needsAttention.title: NACD New England programming committee
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow at 1 PM on Zoom. A few notes on what the committee should take on this cycle are worth jotting tonight, while you still have a connection.

flagged.title: VP, Government Affairs alert
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced a Ladders VP, Government Affairs posting from Sept 14 — worth a scan when you're back online.

flagged.title: Independent Managers Club intro
flagged.detail: Michael Lubrano is lining up a Mercer/Marsh pension-advisory intro for Chie Mitsui; you're cc'd, nothing owed from you.

flagged.title: Philip wants to reconnect
flagged.detail: A Maine friend wrote before leaving Saturday for a two-week Med cruise; a short reply keeps the thread warm.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, LinkedIn digests, and receipts — America's Test Kitchen, WSJ Economics, a $60 Venmo from Tim Pacey, and a CMP autopay confirmation.
inbox.clear: Nothing security- or account-related needs you this morning.

recipe.title: Borlotti beans with sautéed baby kale
recipe.why: A slow, cool-weather bean braise for the first real bite of September — borlotti and kale lean straight into autumn up in Maine.

tasks.title: Check for a better St Pete Airbnb before the Sept 18 charge

acts.line: Under sail on the Adriatic, with nothing on the calendar to pull you off the water.
The day is open; Saturday's disembark logistics want a signal window while you have one.
Tomorrow brings the NACD New England programming committee at 1 — worth a few notes tonight.
